_note: Tuesday resolution cards for the 8-week review gate (src/ledger/gate.ts). Append one object per card when you post it: { "tuesday": "YYYY-MM-DD", "x_post_id": "<numeric id from the post URL, x.com/Paratrosinjury/status/<id>>" }. tuesday is the Tuesday of the pass the card reports, even if the card posts after midnight. The report checks each id on X and counts it when the post was created between Monday 18:00 ET and the end of that gate week (Saturday). Never list a card for a week that did not post one: an unlisted week reads not_listed, which is the honest answer. Read by src/scripts/ledger-gate-report.ts only.
